items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I did want to ask you, you went to the West Coast for a while, and got to work with Oliver Nelson?

ctx.x: Yes. You’ve just done so many things I don’t know where to stop. I did want to ask you, you went to the West Coast for a while, and got to work with Oliver Nelson?
